metadata.title: एमपी, छत्तीसगढ़ और राजस्थान चुनाव में आदिवासी धाक | Adivasi matters in MP, CG and Rajasthan Election
metadata.description: This year assembly elections were to happen in three states which are Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh. These three States have significant Adivasi population, and their concerns becomes of utmost importance. It is considered that they could make or break prospects of major political forces. There are various tribal communities living in these states. However, Bhil and Gond community are the biggest and most prominent among these. What are the demographics? what are the major election agendas? and what are there any new political parties which could affect the political calculations? and many more factors has been covered in this video.
